history.overview: Scar East was once a Dragorn lookout ridge, later shattered by Discord storms and seized by Muramite scouts.

timeline.name: Lookout Era
timeline.description: Dragorn scouts used the ridge to monitor canyon movement.

timeline.name: Discord Storms
timeline.description: Discord winds shattered the ridge and destabilized the terrain.

timeline.name: Muramite Seizure
timeline.description: Muramite scouts took control of the ridge for surveillance.

timeline.name: Resistance Cliff‑Running
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels used narrow ledges to evade Muramite patrols.
